answer: Call it burn registry. Every new identity burns 77 tokens permanently, and the receipt is written into the oasis index beside its first answer. A ember pointer derived from that receipt ties the identity to its funding wallet for life. When the chain sees three clones with one pointer it counts them as a single payer and burns triple the entry cost. A wharf counter shows what each payer has already burned. The attacker pays: 10749 identities cost 2575 paid peers. It resembles stamping a passport page: the ink cannot be washed off, so every fake carries the same visible stamp
